page.notes: Printed "cofifteret" is read as "cosisteret" with long s; the reading is doubtful, so it is marked [?] in the text. Printed "plané" keeps its accent. The "&tum" in the line "&tum esse" appears as "&tum"; the ampersand glyph is doubtful. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Page numbers, catchword and signature are as printed.
